title: canary-release-pinning-checklist-scratchpad
content:
Personal scratchpad - Canary release pinning + checklist

Context:
- Prep notes for upcoming model rollout (gptx-1.4-opt). Target: hosted + dedicated, global.
- Goal: safe canary, measurable health signals, quick rollback path.
- Reason for pinning: ensure stable kv-cache compatibility; avoid silent perf regressions from new kernel picks.

High-level plan:
1) Config pinning:
   - Pin model artifact: model:gptx-1.4-opt@2024-03-05
   - Pin runtime image: inference-runtime:2024-02-28
   - Pin quantization profile: q4_0_v2
   - Config example in rollout config: "model_version": "gptx-1.4-opt@2024-03-05"

2) Canary schedule (target 6 hours):
   - 0-30m: 0.5% traffic (smoke)
   - 30-90m: 2% (basic feature coverage)
   - 90-180m: 10% (load increases)
   - 180-360m: 25% if all green -> expand per business OK

3) Key metrics to monitor (thresholds):
   - Error rate (5xx + model errors): < 0.5%
   - P95 latency (inference excl. networking): < 450ms
   - Token cost variance: < +10% vs baseline
   - Quality checks (sampling): no >5% degradation in eval prompts

4) Health checks / automated gates:
   - Canary eval harness run every 15m: run 50 prompts -> compare bleu/embedding similarity/LLR
   - Synthetic traffic heartbeat: qps ~1% of production for canary nodes
   - CPU/GPU mem pressure alerts: GPU mem > 85% -> alert pager, pause rollout

5) Rollback plan:
   - Immediate action: set route weight -> 0% for canary model, route to previous pinned model
   - Redux steps: revert model_version in config, redeploy runtime image if kernel mismatch suspected
   - Post-mortem owner assigned within 24h

6) Ops commands (quick):
   - Shift traffic manual (example):
     curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/rollouts/update -d '{"route":"chat-gen","weights":{"gptx-1.4-opt@2024-03-05":0.0,"gptx-1.3-stable@2024-01-10":1.0}}'

7) QA / sampling checklist:
   - Run canary eval set (eval/canary/2024-03) and compare scores -> should be within thresholds
   - Human review: sample 30 generated chats across long/short prompts
   - Verify function-calling and tool invocation in canary path

Open questions / TODOs:
- Should we also pin kernel-level feature flags (attention-opt v2)? (ask infra)
- Confirm Dedicated capacity autoscale policy will not preempt canary nodes during window
- Add more lateral monitoring: per-model KV cache hit rate

Notes to self:
- Keep canary window conservative if any unknown traffic spikes expected (marketing campaigns next week).
- Document exact rollback steps in runbook and share with on-call before kickoff.

End of scratchpad.
